phase: Phase 7.1: Redis Durability, Failover, and Guarantee-Compatibility Audit

workstream_a_durability.replication_model: Asynchronous by default; writes acknowledged prior to replica fsync
workstream_a_durability.mitigation: Optional WAIT command adds synchronous replication at +2-5ms latency penalty

workstream_b_idempotency_matrix.same_fp_present: PASS (Exact cached decision returned, zero state mutation)
workstream_b_idempotency_matrix.same_fp_expired: CONDITIONAL (Fresh evaluation occurs after tau_idemp=60s; causes duplicate debit)
workstream_b_idempotency_matrix.conflicting_fp_expired: PASS (Fresh evaluation occurs; cost debited as new request)
workstream_b_idempotency_matrix.failover_loss_idemp_only: CONDITIONAL (State present but idemp key dropped -> duplicate debit)
workstream_b_idempotency_matrix.state_missing_idemp_present: PASS (Cached decision returned; state NOT recreated)

workstream_c_cluster_advanced.moved_redirection: PASS (JedisCluster automatically refreshes slot cache on MOVED)
workstream_c_cluster_advanced.ask_redirection: PASS (Transparent retry during slot migration verified)
workstream_c_cluster_advanced.failover_recovery: PASS (Replica promotion handled transparently by JedisCluster)
workstream_c_cluster_advanced.noscript_recovery: PASS (Limiter catches NOSCRIPT and reloads Lua SHA1 automatically)
workstream_c_cluster_advanced.cross_slot_multi_client: FAIL (Multi-tenant multi-key scripts rejected with CROSSSLOT error; strictly single-tenant)

workstream_d_state_lifecycle.active_state_ttl: 0 (Disabled / persistent state hash; eliminates abuse reset vulnerability)
workstream_d_state_lifecycle.memory_exhaustion_protection: maxmemory-policy noeviction throws OOM, triggering FAIL_CLOSED INFRASTRUCTURE_ERROR

workstream_e_clock_failure.backward_step_clamping: PASS (Clamped to elapsed_sec=0; eliminates negative refill and credit rollback)
workstream_e_clock_failure.forward_jump_acceleration: PASS (Accelerated refill strictly capped at burstMax and sustainedMax)
workstream_e_clock_failure.failover_clock_skew: CONDITIONAL (Dependent on host NTP synchronization across cluster nodes)

workstream_f_mathematical_guarantees.G1_burst_envelope: CONDITIONAL (Violated during un-replicated failover window; valid under normal operations)
workstream_f_mathematical_guarantees.G2_sustained_ceiling: CONDITIONAL (Violated if persistence or failover loses debits; valid under normal operations)
workstream_f_mathematical_guarantees.G3_abuse_score_recovery: PASS (Abuse score decays monotonically; immune to TTL reset when activeStateTtl=0)
workstream_f_mathematical_guarantees.Theorem_2_monotonicity: CONDITIONAL (Strictly monotonic within node; non-monotonic across asynchronous failover rollback)
